a.lede: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
a.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’

b.lede: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.
b.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
